scientific_integrity: Infinite statements are established in the displayed proof; 300 independent shortest-path test cases support but do not certify it. Literature coverage is non-exhaustive.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to h>=3, a a positive multiple of h^3-h+1, d>0 and precisely four displayed generators; no unrestricted higher-base theorem is claimed. Finite verification is not a universal proof.
title: Pseudo-Frobenius spectra of a higher-base shifted-power semigroup at terminal-offset multiples
